name: 06-budgets
teaches: A budget bounds the guest VM's instructions and memory — not wall-clock time and not spawns: one program finishes under a bound it fits inside, and exits 1 partway through under one it does not.
cmd: echo '$ drt run app.dlua'; drt run app.dlua; echo "exit $?"; echo; echo '$ drt run --config bounded.json'; drt run --config bounded.json; echo "exit $?"; echo; echo '$ drt run --config tight.json'; drt run --config tight.json; echo "exit $?"
